addons.edge-tts.summary: Microsoft Edge's online neural voices. No install — works out of the box, requires an internet connection.
addons.piper-tts.summary: Lightweight offline neural TTS based on Piper. Models around 50 MB each.
addons.coqui-xtts.summary: Multilingual neural TTS with 6-second voice cloning. Heavy: ~2 GB model, CPU or CUDA.
addons.org.subtitld.vosk.summary: Offline speech-to-text using Vosk Kaldi recognizers. Lightweight and CPU-only; models are downloaded on demand.

plaintext_panel.format_srt: SubRip (SRT). Speaker, translations and dubs are kept as # comments before each subtitle.
plaintext_panel.format_md: Markdown: [00:00:00.000 - 00:00:00.000] Speaker {key=value}, the text below it, then translations as > language: text. Dubs are kept but not shown.
plaintext_panel.stale: The subtitles changed elsewhere while this text had edits that are not applied.
plaintext_panel.reload_tooltip: Discard the edits here and show the subtitles as they are now
plaintext_panel.keep_tooltip: Apply this text when it is valid, replacing the other changes
plaintext_panel.discard_text: This text has errors, so its edits are not in the subtitles yet. Switching the format rewrites the text from the subtitles and loses those edits.
plaintext_panel.issue_time_format: '{token}' is not a time; write it as {example}
plaintext_panel.issue_end_before_start: The end time must be after the start time
plaintext_panel.issue_out_of_order: Starts before the previous subtitle; it will be put in order
plaintext_panel.issue_comment_detached: A comment must come directly before a subtitle; remove the blank line after it
plaintext_panel.issue_number_missing: Write the subtitle number on the line above the timing
plaintext_panel.issue_timing_missing: Expected the timing line (00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,000) after the number
plaintext_panel.issue_comment_reserved: '{key}' comes from the timing and text lines, not a comment
plaintext_panel.issue_comment_duplicate: '{key}' is set twice for this subtitle
plaintext_panel.issue_text_before_first: Text before the first timing line
plaintext_panel.issue_attr_reserved: '{key}' comes from the timing and text lines
plaintext_panel.issue_attr_kept: '{key}' is kept with the subtitle but cannot be edited in Markdown; use SRT
plaintext_panel.issue_attr_duplicate: '{key}' is set twice for this subtitle
plaintext_panel.issue_text_after_transla: Write the subtitle text above its translations
plaintext_panel.format_json: JSON in Whisper's format: {"segments": [{"id", "start", "end", "text", …}]}, every other field as a key of its segment. Whisper's own output can be pasted as it is.
plaintext_panel.issue_json_expect_key: Expected a key in double quotes
plaintext_panel.issue_json_root: Write an object with a "segments" list
plaintext_panel.issue_json_segment: Each segment must be an object
plaintext_panel.issue_json_number: '{key}' must be a number of seconds
plaintext_panel.status_errors_tooltip: This text has errors, so it is not applied: the timeline keeps the last valid text.
plaintext_panel.status_warnings_tooltip: The timeline shows this text. Warnings do not stop it from being applied.
audio_panel.chain_hint: The sound runs through these from top to bottom, before the track's volume.
audio_panel.chain_empty: No effects on this track yet.
audio_panel.effect_eq_hint: Shape the tone: cut rumble, add presence or air
audio_panel.effect_compressor_hint: Even out the loud and the quiet passages
audio_panel.effect_power: Turn this effect on or off
autosave_panel.backup_description: Copies of the project in Subtitld's backup folder, apart from your own file.
autosave_panel.original_description: Writes your .usfx file itself, as Save does.
autosave_panel.no_backups_project: No backups of this project yet. With changes to keep, one is made every few minutes.
subtitldcc.connect_tip: Opens subtitld.cc in your browser to connect this computer
subtitldcc.use_code_tip: Connect by typing a code at subtitld.cc/device, on any device
subtitldcc.disconnect_text: Subtitld will stop publishing and rating as you on this computer. Finding public subtitles keeps working.
subtitldcc.connect_why: Connect to publish your subtitles, rate others and see the ones shared with you. Finding public subtitles works without it.
subtitldcc.device_wait: Go to {uri} on any device and enter this code:
subtitldcc.works_tip: Tell others these subtitles sync with the video open in Subtitld (sends its fingerprint, never its name)
subtitldcc.works_counted: Thanks! {count} people say it works with their video.
subtitldcc.works_already: You had already said so. {count} people say it works with their video.
subtitldcc.open_tip: Replace the subtitles in the editor with these
subtitldcc.replace_text: The subtitles in the editor will be replaced by “{title}”.
subtitldcc.replace_unsaved: The subtitles in the editor have unsaved changes. Replace them with “{title}”? Your changes will be lost.
subtitldcc.auto_lookup: Look up subtitles when a video opens
subtitldcc.auto_lookup_tip: Sends fingerprints of the video file to subtitld.cc, never its name or contents
subtitldcc.no_video: Open a video to find subtitles for it.
subtitldcc.lookup_off: Not looked up. Press Look up to find subtitles for this video.
subtitldcc.no_matches: No subtitles on subtitld.cc for this video yet.
subtitldcc.match_exact_tip: Published or confirmed for this very file
subtitldcc.match_probable_tip: Same OpenSubtitles hash and size: most likely the same video
subtitldcc.publish_connect: Connect to publish these subtitles on subtitld.cc.
subtitldcc.publish_empty: There are no subtitles in the editor yet.
subtitldcc.publish_text: Share the subtitles in the editor on subtitld.cc.
subtitldcc.publish_version_text: Publish your changes as version {version} of “{title}”, or as a new subtitle.
subtitldcc.which_text: Which text do you want to publish?
subtitldcc.checking: Checking the subtitles… You can keep working meanwhile.
subtitldcc.check_blocked: These subtitles can’t be published as they are:
subtitldcc.check_warnings: {count} lines checked. Have a look before you continue:
subtitldcc.suggestion_duplicate: The same subtitles are already on subtitld.cc: “{title}” by @{owner}. You could rate them instead.
subtitldcc.suggestion_resync: “{title}” by @{owner} has the same text with different timing.
subtitldcc.visibility_restricted: Restricted: only people and groups you choose
subtitldcc.public_license: Public subtitles are always CC BY 4.0: anyone can reuse them with credit to the owner.
subtitldcc.changelog_required: Say what changed in this version.
subtitldcc.with_video: Made for the video open in Subtitld
subtitldcc.with_video_tip: People with the same video file will find these subtitles. Sends the video's fingerprints, never the file.
subtitldcc.conflict_text: You opened version {opened}, but version {latest} was published since. If you publish anyway, yours won't include those changes.
subtitldcc.error_unauthorized: Subtitld is no longer connected to subtitld.cc. Connect again.
subtitldcc.outdated: This version of Subtitld is too old to publish on subtitld.cc. Update Subtitld at subtitld.org.
subtitldcc.changed_since_check: The subtitles changed after they were checked. Check them again to publish the changes, or publish them as they were checked.
subtitldcc.error_offline: Can't reach subtitld.cc. Check your internet connection.
subtitldcc.error_timeout: Connecting took too long. Try again.
subtitldcc.error_access_denied: Connecting was canceled in the browser.
subtitldcc.published_next: To send changes later, edit the subtitles and use “Publish new version” in this card. Save the project to keep this link to subtitld.cc.
subtitldcc.delete_question: Delete “{title}” from subtitld.cc? Its page, all its versions and the downloads are removed for everyone, and this can't be undone. The subtitles in the editor stay.
subtitldcc.deleted: “{title}” was deleted from subtitld.cc. The subtitles in the editor are still here.
